abby: Quick kickoff  we need a compact field pack for regulated buyers: one-pager, 300-word launch post, 30-min webinar hook, and a tiny inbound routing playbook. Target draft by Tue EOD.

rick: Agreed. For the one-pager should we call out hard SLAs? Customers in finance/healthcare expect numbers.

maya: Ops suggested numbers: Hosted: 99.9% uptime, P95 <= 130ms (1k tokens). Dedicated: 99.975% uptime, P95 <= 75ms. Private: SLA negotiable; sample line: "Customer-managed infra; SLA terms defined in contract." I'll confirm.

tom: I'll write the one-pager and social blurb. Need perf CSV from eng for p95 and cost-per-1k tokens. rick, can you grab the 2k token runs and note batching assumptions?

rick: Yep. Dedicated tests assume reserved 8x A100 pools and throughput batching; Hosted uses mixed-precision small-batch serving. I'll attach notes.

abby: Sales bullets for the field (one column): 1) Predictable SLA & pricing, 2) Data tenancy + KMS/HSM + audit logs, 3) Same API across modes, 4) Migration + automatic fallback. Add 2 qualification Qs: "Does data need to remain on-prem?" and "Estimated annual token volume?"

maya: Inbound routing pseudo-rule: if form contains keywords (on-prem, air-gapped, data residency) OR annual_tokens > 50M => route to enterprise AE queue; else => route to PS. I'll drop a tiny HubSpot snippet in assets.

tom: Webinar hook: "Compliant serving for regulated apps: latency, cost, and controls"  30 mins, demo canary + failover to Hosted, CTA: download compliance checklist / book a scoping call. I'll draft slides.

rick: I'll produce a short benchmark callout for the post (50-75 words) comparing p95 and cost delta across modes, with a footnote on measurement assumptions.

ops-bot: Reminder: upload perf files to /shared/perf/reg_launch_3890011223.csv and /shared/perf/dedicated_3890011223.csv.

abby: Timeline: tom + rick drop drafts by Tue EOD, maya confirms SLA wording Tue noon. I'll assemble Wed morning and circulate. Anything missing?

tom: Add a one-slide compliance checklist as downloadable asset. I'll include it in the deck. :rocket:
